svg.title: With Claude Haiku 5.5, image and OCR text together keep forms and checks right
svg.desc: RealKIE invoices, 20 documents × 3 runs: Weighted accuracy: Page image and OCR text (baseline setup) 79% at $51.0 per 1,000 documents, OCR text only 79% at $49.2 per 1,000 documents, Page image only 77% at $49.2 per 1,000 documents; Documents with every field right: Page image and OCR text (baseline setup) 0% at $51.0 per 1,000 documents, OCR text only 0% at $49.2 per 1,000 documents, Page image only 0% at $49.2 per 1,000 documents; Fake-W2 forms, 20 documents × 3 runs: Weighted accuracy: Page image and OCR text (baseline setup) 100% at $14.0 per 1,000 documents, OCR text only 91% at $14.3 per 1,000 documents, Page image only 99% at $13.6 per 1,000 documents; Documents with every field right: Page image and OCR text (baseline setup) 82% at $14.0 per 1,000 documents, OCR text only 2% at $14.3 per 1,000 documents, Page image only 50% at $13.6 per 1,000 documents; OmniAI bank checks, 19–20 documents × 3 runs: Weighted accuracy: Page image and OCR text (baseline setup) 99% at $14.0 per 1,000 documents, OCR text only 89% at $13.2 per 1,000 documents, Page image only 98% at $13.4 per 1,000 documents; Documents with every field right: Page image and OCR text (baseline setup) 38% at $14.0 per 1,000 documents, OCR text only 2% at $13.2 per 1,000 documents, Page image only 30% at $13.4 per 1,000 documents; Baseline setup: Amazon Textract with Layout only; holistic classification reading text and page images, single-pass extraction with structured output, and confidence scoring, all on Claude Haiku 5.5, with no escalation to a second scoring model.
